$comment: Per-community accent colours for the mobile app.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. HeroUI Native resolves its accent from a CSS variable that
uniwind compiles at BUILD time, and neither library exposes a way to change an
arbitrary colour while the app is running (verified against uniwind@1.7.0 and
heroui-native@1.0.4). The web app sets the same variable at runtime; mobile cannot.
So the colours have to be known when the bundle is built, and this is where they
are declared. scripts/generate-tenant-themes.mjs turns them into named uniwind
themes and lib/theme/themeStore.ts selects one once the tenant is known.
ADDING A COMMUNITY. Add an entry, run `npm run themes:generate`, commit the
generated CSS, and ship it with `npm run update:production` — the CSS lives in the
JS bundle, so this reaches devices as an over-the-air update and does NOT need an
app-store release. Until that update lands, a new community falls back to the
platform default accent, which looks deliberate rather than broken.
`accent` is the community's own brand colour as stored in the database at
tenants.configuration.primary_color. `accentDark` is optional: when omitted the
generator lightens the accent for dark mode, mirroring what the platform default
does between its own light and dark values.
ONLY communities whose colour DIFFERS from the platform default belong here. The
default accent in global.css is now FALLBACK_PRIMARY (#006FEE), which is what
usePrimaryColor() returns for a community with no colour of its own — so those
communities are already self-consistent and adding them here would generate a
theme identical to the default.

agoris.note: Teal. The only local tenant with a real primary_color, so it is the test case for a community whose colour is nothing like the platform default.
